title: Mood Sleep Pressure Check
caption: This is a good day to compare symptoms and signals. Energy may be jumpy and tired, so do short task bursts and take a brisk walk or quick stretches between them.
snapshot: The near-space picture today is quiet overall with a mildly southward-directed component. Background resonance shows a livelier level than average. No recent flares or CMEs were reported. Expect low aurora activity in the coming days.
affects: People may notice a tug between feeling overstimulated and low on fuel. Restlessness and low stamina can happen together, and small tasks may feel scattered. For some, short resets help more than long effort stretches.
playbook:
- Split tasks into short bursts with 5-minute movement breaks
- Try a brisk walk or simple stretches midday
- Keep snacks and water handy to avoid energy slumps
- Pause for three slow breaths when tension rises

fb.caption: Feeling wired but tired? Imagine an over-caffeinated squirrel on a calm afternoon — there’s motion, but things aren’t chaotic. The field today sits in a quiet-to-normal zone and the Schumann rhythm is lively, which can show up as jittery energy in the body even when overall conditions are steady. That can make it easy to fidget or lie awake with a busy mind. A short paced walk and a warm drink earlier in the evening may help the body settle into a slower rhythm before bed. Notice what your nervous system likes and lean into the small routines that soothe it. From Gaia Eyes.
